source: GearBox_adddingImg v1 by Vjs, Roboflow Universe (https://universe.roboflow.com/vjs-jek7v/gearbox_adddingimg), CC BY 4.0; real photos
notes: sensor: six rounds, each holding out one working condition (2 or 6 rpm, 0/30/60 N); one slewing support per class, so the model may partly learn the individual ring
images: a SEPARATE two-class task (good vs damaged tooth crops of small gears), not the slewing ring; scored by balanced accuracy because 94% of crops are good teeth
images: frozen ResNet-18 features + logistic regression, settings fixed in advance; choosing them inside the training sources is saved as a check
test: fair test: hold out each video or photo set in turn (frames of one video never on both sides); frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 features + logistic regression
